title: Throughput-Latency Token Tapestry: Adaptive Panel Specs for Model & Route Telemetry
creator: Evelyn Chen
description: Design a compact, adaptive panel system for the Console that surfaces per-model and per-route telemetry across three primary dimensions: latency (P50/P95/P99), throughput (requests/s and tokens/s), and token-level metrics (avg tokens, token-cost estimates). The 'Tapestry' concept consolidates dense micro-visuals (sparklines + quantile bands + small multiple histograms) with an affordance for quick rollups (route/model/region) and fast drill-in to the existing Route Inspector. This ticket covers wireframes, chart specs, accessibility considerations, and a high-fidelity prototype to validate layout density and visual hierarchy at 320–1440px widths.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma prototype with responsive variants (mobile/compact/desktop) linked in attachments
Chart spec doc enumerating data inputs, aggregation frequencies, downsampling rules, and color/threshold tokens
Hand-off notes for frontend and telemetry infra with explicit metric/event names and SLO visualization rules
Usability sign-off from PM (cost visibility) and Eng (feasible with current telemetry schema)
design_notes: Primary panel behaviour: adaptive density — shows 4 tiles in compact mode, up to 9 tiles in expanded overview
Each tile includes: title, micro-sparkline (last 1h), quantile latency ribbon (P50/P95/P99), throughput bar, avg tokens numeric, cost-estimate tag
Color semantics: green/yellow/red mapped to team SLO thresholds; neutral grey for insufficient data
Interaction: hover reveals 60s micro-trace snapshot; click opens Route Inspector with time-synced timeline
Rollups: allow user to toggle aggregation window (1m/5m/1h/24h) and group by model version / route / region
Data fallback: when KV-cache-hit metric present, show small prefix marker to denote cached responses (reduces apparent latency)
notes_for_engineering: Frontend should receive aggregated timeseries at 1s granularity for clickable windows, with server-side downsampling for >1h ranges
Provide explicit metric names: latency_ms{p50,p95,p99}, req_per_s, tokens_per_s, avg_input_tokens, avg_output_tokens, cost_per_1k_tokens
Expose KV cache hit ratio as kv_cache_hit_ratio to annotate tiles
SLO overlay API: return {thresholds: {p50:250, p95:1000, p99:3000}} to render color ribbons
ux_risks: High data density may overwhelm new users — add a guided first-time overlay
Latency ribbons require consistent quantile computation across infra — mismatches will erode trust
Cost estimates are sensitive; must include a disclaimer and link to exact billing calc
